name: DrazCanna, Inc.
summary: Operating as Global Personalized Academics, DrazCanna, Inc. functions as an educational enterprise. It delivers both virtual and in-person learning resources to students and teachers across the globe. The company's diverse offerings include digital curricula designed for K-12 students, covering essential subjects, electives, Advanced Placement (AP) courses, world languages, and credit recovery programs. Additionally, DrazCanna provides professional development for educators, available through both online platforms and traditional classroom sessions, along with access to learning management software. Its services extend to comprehensive online school solutions, which bundle online courses, learning management systems, and instructor support, typically charged per student on a semester basis. International dual-diploma courses are also part of its portfolio. The company currently serves approximately 150 school districts throughout the United States. DrazCanna, Inc. was established in 2010 and is headquartered in Orlando, Florida. It previously operated under the name Sibling Group Holdings, Inc., before officially changing to DrazCanna, Inc. in March 2022.
